confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are the firmest. Hostel and hotel rates vary widely by season and platform and are less certain, especially the 3-star tier. Cocktail and wine anchors are weakly grounded and were set from the local beer relationship. Assumes ordinary July 2026 conditions, not festival peaks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian heritage tourism cities such as Melaka, Chiang Mai and Da Nang at similar price levels, with accommodation set somewhat below Kuala Lumpur. No named sources or live price data were used.
